programme.title: Sa e ke numrin?
programme.desc: Anna Faris, Chris Evans. Një vajzë beson se shansi për të gjetur njeriun perfekt tashmë ka kaluar. E bindur se ndoshta njëri prej ish të dashurve është i duhuri, ajo përpiqet t’i takojë sërish për t’i dhënë vetes një mundësi të dytë...

programme.title: S1E21 - Të Gjithë Cmënden pas Rejmondit
programme.desc: Rei Barone i ka të gjitha në jetë: një familje të madhe, një punë të mirë dhe një shtëpi të bukur. Problemi i vetëm i tij janë prindërit dhe vëllai i tij xheloz, të cilët jetojnë në anën tjetër të rrugës. Telashet nuk kanë të sosur në këtë familje të madhe, por Reimondi ka mësuar si t’i përballojë ato.

programme.sub-title: Sweetness in Nature
programme.desc: This episode starts with the unique salt from Reyjanes in the Westfjords of Iceland, revealing the perfect harmony between sweet and salty in nature. The combination of saltiness and sweetness offers diners a new understanding of the sensory experience of natual balance. In Turpan, Xinjiang, the people's deep love for grapes reflects a pursuit of the most primitive flavors, emphasizing the charm of natural ingredients. The brewing process of native Dutch mead showcases the miracles of nature, creating one of the oldest alcoholic beverages on Earth without human intervention. This episode not only demonstrates the diversity and complexity of sweetness but also shows us that nature itself is the greatest brewer, reminding us to return to nature and enjoy the pure sweetness in life.

They demonstrate how food can become a symbol of cultural identity and family heritage. As Xiaoyang, a young women from Fuzhou, China, says: \.

As people move from city to city and country to country, they spread their culinary cultures. The program reveals the unique attraction of sweet food that allows it to transcend geographical boundaries to become a bond shared worldwide, a form of cultural expression, and a means of heritage prevention.

programme.title: Jhoom Barabar Jhoom
programme.desc: A man and a woman, engaged to marry different people, spend a couple of hours chatting together at a train station only to fall for each other. Release Year: 2007 Director: Shaad Ali.

programme.title: Badmaash Company
programme.desc: Karan, a middle-class graduate, is heartbroken when his mother sells her jewelry for his father's treatment. Determined to fix it, he hatches a plan to get rich fast, risking everything. Release Year: 2010 Director: Parmeet Sethi.

programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: In Goa, Sameer falls for Rani, but his roommate Sunny, also smitten, sabotages Sameer's chances, sparking a heated rivalry for Rani's heart, testing friendship and love. Release Year: 2004 Director: David Dhawan Awards: Best Art Direction: Sharmishta Roy Screen Weekly Awards; Best Performance in a Comic Role: Akshay Kumar, Best Background Score, Best Costume Design Awards of the International Indian Film Academy.

programme.title: Angrezi Medium
programme.desc: Though Champak initially disapproves, he eventually does everything in his power while going through a series of hilarious mishaps to fulfil his daughter's dream of going to London to study further. Release Year: 2020 Director: Homi Adajania Awards: 2021 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Actor- Irrfan Khan.

programme.title: Fanaa
programme.desc: A blind Kashmiri girl travels without her parents for the first time with a dance troupe to Delhi to perform in a ceremony for Independence Day. Release Year: 2006 Director: Kunal Kohli Awards: Filmfare Awards- Best ActreSS- Kajol, Best Lyrics- Prasoon Joshi, Best Playback Singer - Shaan and Kailash Kher for the song Chaand sifarish.

programme.title: Golmaal Again
programme.desc: The gang of five encounters some spiritual bodies and finds out the truth about the Jamnadas Orphanage where they were brought up. Release Year: 2017 Director: Rohit Shetty Awards: Zee Cine Award for Best Film, Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Award for Favorite Film, Dadasaheb Phalke Award for Best Actor in a Comic Role.

programme.title: Waiting
programme.desc: Tara and Shiv meet at a hospital where their spouses are admitted. The two develop an extraordinary friendship as they get to know each other.

programme.title: Nakhuda
programme.desc: Ravi marries into wealth, but remains loyal to Sheikhu, who helped him in his darkest hour. However, his gratitude sparks tension with his father-in-law, Jagannath, who disapproves of their bond. Release Year: 1981 Director: Dilip Naik.

programme.title: Rocket Singh
programme.sub-title: Salesman Of The Year
programme.desc: Harpreet, a fresh graduate, enters sales but struggles with its demands. He seeks balance between career pressures and his inner values, finding an unconventional solution that transforms his world. Release Year: 2009 Director: Shimit Amin Awards: 55th Filmfare Awards 2010: Best Actor Critics - Ranbir Kapoor, GQ Awards India 2010: Actor of the Year - Ranbir Kapoo.

programme.title: Love Sonia
programme.desc: Love Sonia.

programme.title: Betaab
programme.desc: Love story of two youngsters who fall in love despite the status gaps between their families and must face the odds to stay together. Release Year: 1983 Director: Rahul Rawail.

programme.title: Dhoom 3
programme.desc: Sahir, a circus entertainer, robs a bank in Chicago in order to avenge his father's death. His troubles increase when inspector Jai and Ali suspect him. Release Year: 2013 Director: Vijay Krishna Acharya Awards: 2014 Nominee Popular Award - Best Film Aditya Chopra, 2014 Winner Box Office India Award - Film Of The Year.

programme.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
programme.desc: An NRI couple decide to stay in his ancestral home. Inexplicable occurrences cause him to call a psychiatrist to solve the mystery. Release Year: 2007 Director: Nupur Asthana Awards: 2008 Winner Reader's Choice- Star of the Year - Actor Akshay Kumar.

programme.title: Padmaavat
programme.desc: A princess Padmavati marries King Ratan Singh of Chittor and lives until a banished priest persuades Delhi's Sultan Khilji to attack, seeking her beauty. Release Year: 2018 Director: Sanjay Leela Bhansali Awards: Filmfare Awards 2019, National Film Awards 2019, IIFA Awards 2019, Zee Cine Awards 2019, Screen Awards 2019.

programme.title: Andhadhun
programme.desc: Andhadhun.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime. Release Year: 2015 Director: Nishikant Kamat Awards: 2016 Winner Apsara Award- Best ActreSS in a Supporting Role- Tabu.

programme.title: Luv Ka The End
programme.desc: Rhea dreams of marrying her boyfriend but plans revenge when she finds out that he is using her to score points. Release Year: 2011 Awards: Stardust Searchlight Award for Best ActreSS 2012: Shraddha Kapoor.

programme.title: Mohabbat Mein Jung
programme.desc: Shankar, a mehendi artist, falls for Priya, the daughter of a zamindar. However, the disparity in their backgrounds becomes an obstacle in their relationship.

programme.title: Motichoor Chaknachoor
programme.desc: Anita dreams of marrying a foreign-settled man. She chooses Pushpinder, a Dubai-returned bachelor desperate for a bride, but their expectations clash in hilarious and heartfelt ways. Release Year: 2019 Director: Debamitra Biswal.

programme.title: Boss
programme.desc: After being disowned by his father, a businessman raises Surya as his own. Years later, Surya becomes Boss, fighting for the rights of society's deprived and oppressed, seeking justice and change. Release Year: 2013 Director: Anthony D'Souza.

programme.title: Saas Bahu Aur Sensex

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life

programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: Wild By Nature
programme.desc: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth.

programme.title: Sharkzilla Takes New York
programme.desc: After a slew of mauled marine life washes ashore in NY, Dr. Craig O'Connell starts a search to find the culprit. When it leads him to an old nuclear dumping ground ringed with great whites and makos, he theorizes that the predator may be radioactive.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.sub-title: Discover how some of the world's most extraordinary animals are also the smallest. This action-packed episode will take you deep into rainforests, under the oceans and across vast deserts
programme.desc: Bringing you the best in entertainment. We explore the lives of nature's wildest animals from all corners of the world, and see how they have learned to adapt, both to survive and to evolve.

programme.title: A Cheetah's Pride
programme.sub-title: Rejoin the cheetah family as the mothers collaborate to keep the cubs fed, then watch the cubs survive abandonment and harsh conditions
programme.desc: Witness a wildlife first: two cheetah mothers unite to raise nine cubs in South Africa's Karoo, overcoming danger, loss, and the odds to survive.

programme.title: Life in Colour with David Attenborough
programme.sub-title: David Attenborough reveals the extraordinary ways that some animals use colour to hide and disappear into the background. New science reveals how the Bengal tiger in central India uses its orange-black stripes to hide from its colour-blind prey. In Kenya's Masai Mara, the zebra's black-and-white pattern confuses predators with an extraordinary effect called motion dazzle. And on the island of Cuba, a small snail uses colourful stripes surprisingly to hide from its enemies
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the vital role that colour plays in the daily life of various species. For us humans, it is a source of aesthetic beauty and expression, but for animals it is an essential tool used for survival and without it, there would be catastrophic consequences. Colours help animals to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies. Attenborough explores nature's use of colour using technological advancements in camera equipment to reveal the world, as seen by animals.

programme.title: Wild Fighters
programme.sub-title: The love rivalry shakes every fibre of the body as hormones invade the blood, and some of the most overwhelming spectacles on the planet are produced; the language of love and the fight for reproduction stimulate the most diverse behaviours
programme.desc: Explores the fights for the survival of various wild creatures and their motivations to win.

With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: चंद्रमुखी
programme.sub-title: Raja Mahendra Pratap Singh learns that his son Vanraj is cursed and sends the child and his mother away. Later, only a mysterious flower from Princess Chandramukhi's kingdom can save them

programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारत के मुजफ्फरपुर शहर में कृषि और खेती से संबंधित कुछ नवीनतम समाचारों, अपडेट और घटनाक्रमों के बारे में बताते हैं।.

programme.title: बिहार थियेटर

programme.title: उड़ान
programme.sub-title: Chakor, a young girl, who was kept as a collateral for money before she was born, grows up into a free-spirited athlete. She raises her voice against the system of bonded labour in her village
programme.desc: जन्म से पहले पैसों के लिए ज़मानत के तौर पर रखी गई चकोर, बड़ी होकर एक स्वतंत्र विचारों वाली एथलीट बन जाती है। वह अपने गाँव में बंधुआ मज़दूरी प्रथा के खिलाफ आवाज़ उठाती है।.

programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: బూనీ బేర్స్: ది అడ్వెంచరర్స్
programme.sub-title: Briar and Bramble, two bear siblings who love their forest home, keep thwarting the nefarious logger Vick's attempts to log timber from their forest
programme.desc: ఎలుగుబంట్లు బ్రియార్, బ్రాంబుల్ తమ అడవి నుండి కలపను లాగడానికి దుర్మార్గపు విక్ చేసిన ప్రయత్నాలను విఫలం చేస్తాయి.

credits.actor: Paul \"Maxx\" Rinehart,Rick Jay Glen,Justin J. Wheeler

programme.title: టియాన్ టియాన్
programme.sub-title: Tiantian, a six-year-old innocent girl, learns about the world as she embarks on an exciting journey with her best friends
programme.desc: ఆరేళ్ళ టియాన్ టియాన్, తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి ఉత్సహభరితమైన ప్రయాణం చేస్తూ, ఈ ప్రపంచం గురించి ఎన్నో విషయాలు తెలుసుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: सिम्बा, एक ईमानदार और साहसी पुलिस अधिकारी, अपने निडर सहयोगियों के साथ मिलकर समाज की बुरी ताकतों का सामना करने और उन्हें हराने के मिशन पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्णा मेलडिज
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: नन्हे कृष्ण वृंदावन में अपने दोस्तों के साथ तरह-तरह की शरारतें करते हुए मज़े करते हैं। लेकिन जब दुष्ट कंस उनके जीवन में खलल डालने के लिए अपने अनुचर भेजता है, तब वे तुरंत हरकत में आ जाते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: एक शरारती बच्चा छोटा कृष्ण वृंदावन गाँव में रहता है। वह क्रूर राक्षसों को ग्रामीणों पर हमला के लिए भेजने वाले एक दुष्ट राजा, कंस से उन्हें बचाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: The filmmaker follows a family of spotted hyenas residing in the Liuwa Plains of Zambia and shows the challenges they face in a rough drought
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार, प्रमुख अफ्रीकी शिकारियों के व्यवहार और भौतिक विशेषताओं को उजागर करते है। वह उनके शिकार करने और खुद की रक्षा के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली रणनीतियाँ भी बताते है।.

programme.sub-title: During the dry season in Ruaha state, a herd of elephants visits the water body at Glade to extract the cleanest water using their trunks
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार राजसी अफ्रीकी शेरों से प्रेरित होकर जीवित रहने की एक शक्तिशाली कहानी को दर्शाते हैं, जिसमें वे भोजन की तलाश करते हैं और अपने क्षेत्र की सुरक्षा के लिए एकजुट होते हैं।.

programme.title: डाई लियोपार्डिन
programme.sub-title: The Serengeti and its dangerous forests are home to a mother leopardess who is both a caring provider and a fearless defender of her family

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.sub-title: Shawn has a bold plan to rebuild the Myrtle Irene. Zeke tests out his unique sailboat dredge, and Vernon exams his claim with an underwater drone
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning \"Deadliest Catch,\" follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.sub-title: An engaging compilation of spiritual hymns and divine melodies presented by renowned devotional singers from across the globe

programme.title: இன்றும் இனியவை

programme.desc: ஒரு அரச குடும்பத்தின் ஒரே வாரிசு மர்மமான முறையில் மறைந்துவிடுவதால், அவளுடைய பாட்டி அவளைத் தேடத் தூண்டப்படுகிறார்.

programme.desc: மாற்றாந்தாய் உடன்பிறப்புகளை ஆதரிக்கும் வித்யா, மோசடிக்காரர் என்பதை அறியாமல் ஒருவரை திருமணம் செய்துகொள்கிறாள்.

programme.desc: வெங்கய்யன் தந்தையை கொன்று, மக்களை அடிமைப்படுத்தினான் தீயவன். அறிவில்லாத வெங்கய்யனை ஜீவா புத்திசாலியாக்க உதவுகிறார்.

programme.sub-title: A genius music director, Damodaran, sinks into depression when his wife dies and his son, Krishna, becomes an alcoholic due to heartbreak. An old friend, Dr Priya, helps him with all his problems
programme.desc: இசையமைப்பாளர் தாமோதரன்,அவரின் மனைவி இறந்தபின் மகனும் குடிகாரனாக அவரது துன்பத்தை நீக்க பிரியா உதவுகிறார்.

programme.title: பெரிய இடத்து மாப்பிள்ளை
programme.sub-title: Two cousins, Lakshmi and Priya, fall in love with the same man, Gopalakrishnan, their families' driver, getting him into serious trouble
programme.desc: உறவினர்களான லக்ஷ்மி மற்றும் பிரியா குடும்ப ஓட்டுநரான கோபாலகிருஷ்ணனை காதலிக்கும்போது கடுமையான பிரச்சினையில் சிக்குகிறார்.

programme.title: மெகா டென் மூவிஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents an in-depth analysis and review of the top ten movies of the week and gives a short summary of the storylines
programme.desc: வாரத்தின் சிறந்த பத்து திரைப்படங்களின் பகுப்பாய்வு மற்றும் மதிப்பாய்வை வழங்கி சுருக்கத்தையும் வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: கோயில் காளை
programme.sub-title: A man devoted to temple life encounters an orphaned woman and fate unites them in marriage. However, complications arise when her true identity comes to light
programme.desc: கோவில் வாழ்க்கைக்கு அர்ப்பணிப்புடன் இருக்கும் ஆண், ஒரு அனாதை பெண்ணை சந்திக்கிறான், விதி அவர்களை திருமணத்தில் இணைக்கிறது.

programme.title: சவரிக்காடு
programme.sub-title: A group of friends decides to travel to Savarikkadu despite learning about the mysteries surrounding the place. Later, they get lost in the forest and try to find each other
programme.desc: மர்மங்கள் நிறைந்த சவரிக்காட்டுக்கு சென்று, தொலைந்து போகும் நண்பர்கள் ஒருவரையொருவர் கண்டுபிடிக்க முயற்சிக்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: உயிர்
programme.sub-title: Sundar lives with his brother's family but is unaware that his sister-in-law Arundathi lusts for him. After his brother's suicide, Sundar is forced to look after Arundathi and her children
programme.desc: சுந்தர் தனது சகோதரனின் குடும்பத்துடன் வசிக்கிறார், ஆனால் அவரது மைத்துனி அருந்ததி அவர் மீது ஆசைப்படுவதை அறியவில்லை.

programme.title: ஆனந்த்
programme.sub-title: Ananda, a popular singer, desperately seeks to win Latha's affection. Upon finally winning her heart, they decide to marry, but a series of misunderstandings soon separates them

programme.title: பந்தம்
programme.sub-title: Abraham disowns his daughter, Mary, after she gets married against his wishes. Years later, he meets his granddaughter Asha and his heart melts seeing her innocence and intelligence
programme.desc: தன் விருப்பத்திற்கு மாறாக திருமணம் செய்த தன் மகள் மேரியை ஏற்காத ஆபிரகாம், தன் பேத்தி ஆஷாவை கண்டதும் மனசு மாறுகிறார்.

credits.actor: Shivaji Ganesan,Kajal Kiran,Shalini,Anand Babu,Nizhalgal Ravi,Jai Shankar,Manorama,Charle,Babloo Prithiveeraj

programme.title: கிழக்கு முகம்
programme.sub-title: A village headman's daughter falls in love with a man who works at a burial ground. After much reluctance, he gives in to his daughter's wish, on the condition that the man leaves his foster mother
programme.desc: மகள் மயானத்தில் பணி புரிபவணை காதலிக்கிறாள். தந்தை வளர்ப்பு தாயை விட்டு சென்றால் மட்டுமே, காதலனை மணக்க அனுமதிக்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Karthik (Venu),Reshma (Poongodi),Radha Ravi (Village President),Anandaraj (Nagaraj),Charle (Mukkka),Delhi Ganesh (Gurukkal),Vadivukkarasi (Venu's Mother),Sathyapriya (Poongodi's Mother)

programme.title: அய்யா வழி சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Devotional artists and singers perform soulful hymns, celebrating Ayya Vaikundar, a 19th-century visionary and social reformer, inspiring faith and social change
programme.desc: பக்திப் பாடகர்கள் 19 ஆம் நூற்றாண்டின் தொலைநோக்கு பார்வையாளரான அய்யா வைகுண்டரைக் கொண்டாடி, பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்

programme.desc: மத தலைவர்கள் பக்தர்களுடன் காலை பிரார்த்தனைகளை ஓதி, சடங்குகளை நடத்தி, இந்து தெய்வங்களை போற்றி பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.sub-title: A group of experienced artists, musicians and singers perform a special patriotic song depicting the beauty, traditions and cultures of India

credits.actor: M. G. Ramachandran,Padmini,Anjali Devi,P. S. Veerappa,M. G. Chakrapani,Kuladeivam V.R. Rajagopal,Narayana Pillai,G. Shakuntala

programme.title: எனக்குள் சினிமா

programme.title: தெய்வீக வழிபாடு

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்
programme.sub-title: At a revered temple in Kerala, priests and devotees unite in devotion, performing sacred rituals and offering heartfelt prayers to Lord Shiva
programme.desc: கேரளாவின் பிரபல கோவிலில், பூசாரிகள்-பக்தர்கள் இணைந்து, சடங்குகளை செய்து, சிவனுக்கு இதயப்பூர்வ வழிபாடுகளை செய்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கும்பாபிஷேகம்
programme.sub-title: Devotees in large numbers visit a temple to perform a special ritual in order to synergise and unite the special powers of the deity
programme.desc: தெய்வத்தின் சிறப்பு சக்திகளை ஒருங்கிணைக்கவும் ஒன்றிணைக்கவும் ஒரு சிறப்பு சடங்கை செய்ய பக்தர்கள் கோயிலுக்கு வருகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஆர்ஜேஆர் - ஹெர்பல் ஸ்லாட்

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்

programme.title: த ஜிப்ஸீஸ்

programme.title: லாண்ட்மார்க்ஸ்

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: हैरी एण्ड बन्नी
programme.sub-title: Harry is an aspiring magician who invents elaborate magic tricks to impress others. However, Bunnie, his mischievous stage rabbit, constantly outsmarts him and steals his spotlight
programme.desc: हैरी एक महत्वाकांक्षी जादूगर है जो दूसरों को प्रभावित करने के लिए नए-नए जादू के खेल ईजाद करता है। हालाँकि, बन्नी, उसका नटखट खरगोश, हर बार उसे मात दे देता है और सारी वाहवाही लूट लेता है।.

programme.sub-title: Mowgli, who is raised by Akela's wolf pack, goes on daily adventures with his friends, Baloo and Bagheera. He tries to help many animals who are in danger
programme.desc: मोगली, जिसे अकेला के भेड़िया झुंड ने पाला है, अपने दोस्तों, बालू और बघीरा के साथ दैनिक रोमांच पर जाता है। वह कई जानवरों की मदद करने की कोशिश करता है जो खतरे में हैं।.

programme.title: टीन टाइटन्स गो!

programme.desc: नायकों का एक समूह रोज़मर्रा की हरकतों के साथ अपराध-विरोधी गतिविधियों को संतुलित करता है, अपनी अपरंपरागत दुनिया में मूर्खतापूर्ण चुनौतियों, अप्रत्याशित रोमांच और हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों का सामना करता है।.

programme.title: लूनी ट्यून्स कार्टून्स
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: बग्स बनी, डैफी डक, पोर्की पिग, सिल्वेस्टर, ट्वीटी, रोड रनर और कई मज़ेदार और अजीब-गरीब घटनाओं से गुज़रते हैं।.

credits.actor: Eric Bauza (Bugs Bunny/Daffy Duck/Marvin the Martian/Tweety),Jeff Bergman (Elmer Fudd/Sylvester/Ralph Wolf),Bob Bergen (Porky Pig),Fred Tatasciore (Yosemite Sam/Gossamer/Sam Sheepdog),Candi Milo (Granny),Michael Ruocco (Beaky Buzzard)

programme.title: ओमी नंबर 1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: ओमी, नौ साल का एक अत्यधिक अमीर वारिस है, जिसका सामना ऐसी हास्यास्पद और आंखें खोल देने वाली स्थितियों से होता है जो उसे जीवन की वास्तविकताओं के बारे में सिखाती हैं।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: लूनी ट्यून्स कार्टून्स
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: बग्स बनी, डैफी डक, पोर्की पिग, सिल्वेस्टर, ट्वीटी, रोड रनर और कई मज़ेदार और अजीब-गरीब घटनाओं से गुज़रते हैं।.

credits.actor: Eric Bauza (Bugs Bunny/Daffy Duck/Marvin the Martian/Tweety),Jeff Bergman (Elmer Fudd/Sylvester/Ralph Wolf),Bob Bergen (Porky Pig),Fred Tatasciore (Yosemite Sam/Gossamer/Sam Sheepdog),Candi Milo (Granny),Michael Ruocco (Beaky Buzzard)

programme.title: ला फामिल वीज़ी
programme.sub-title: Weasy, an opportunistic weasel with a penchant for burglary, finds himself incubating a large egg, which leads to significant changes in his life
programme.desc: चोरी के शौकीन, अवसरवादी नेवले वीज़ी को एक बड़ा अंडा सेने का काम सौंपा जाता है, जिससे उसके जीवन में महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव आते हैं।.

programme.desc: பூங்கொடியின் சுய தேடல் அவளை தன் மாற்றாந்தாயின் சூழ்ச்சிகளால் அறியாமலேயே கட்டுப்படும் சரவணனிடம் அழைத்துச் செல்கிறது.

programme.title: புனிதா
programme.sub-title: A loving bond between Maragatham and her step-daughter, Punitha, goes awry when she falls in love with Kabilan, altering their lives
programme.desc: மரகதம் மற்றும் அவரது வளர்ப்பு மகள் புனிதா இடையேயான ஒரு அன்பான பிணைப்பு, புனித கபிலனைக் காதலிக்கும்போது, ​​மாறுகிறது.

credits.actor: Karthick Vasu,Nimeshika Radhakrishnan,Dasarathy,Ammu Ramachandran,Madhumitha,Tharun Appasamy,Salmaan,Aarthi Ram

programme.title: மணமகளே வா
programme.sub-title: Narmada wants to fix her family, and Kathir needs to find husbands for his sisters. Soon, they fall in love while fighting a common enemy
programme.desc: தன் தந்தையை அவரது குடும்பத்தினருடன் சேர்த்து வைக்க முயலும் நர்மதா, தன் சகோதரிகளுக்கு வரன்களை தேடும் கதிரை சந்திக்கிறார்.

programme.title: புன்னகை பூவே
programme.sub-title: When an old promise of marriage arrangement between Chezhiyan and Kalaivani is broken by Chezhiyan's mother, Kalaivani devises a plan to win Chezhiyan's affection through disguise
programme.desc: செழியனின் தாய் கலைவாணியின் பெற்றோரிடம் தனது மகனுக்கு கலைவாணியை திருமணம் செய்வதாக வாக்குறுதி அளித்தார்.

programme.title: புது வசந்தம்
programme.sub-title: While the parents search for a suitable prospect for their daughter Selvi's marriage, she expresses her desire to get married to a joint family
programme.desc: பெற்றோர் தனக்கு திருமணத்திற்கு வரன் தேடும்போது, கூட்டுக் குடும்பத்தில் திருமணம் செய்ய விருப்பம் தெரிவிக்கும் செல்வி.

credits.actor: Nathan Shyam (Thirumurugan),Surjith Ansary (Sundar),Soniya Suresh (Selvi Velmurugan),Shyam Ji (Velmurugan),Vaishnavi Nayak (Keerthi Thirumurugan)

programme.title: இலக்கியா
programme.sub-title: A selfless woman from a middle-class family finds happiness in helping others. However, her life changes when she encounters an industrialist's son
programme.desc: மற்றவர்களுக்கு உதவுவதில் மகிழ்ச்சியைக் காணும் பெண், ஒரு தொழிலதிபரின் மகனை சந்திக்கும் போது அவளுடைய வாழ்க்கை மாறுகிறது.

credits.actor: Shamvvy Gurumoorthy,Nandan Loganathan,Priya Prince,Gayathiri Shastry,Sushma Nair,Aravish Kumar,Meena Vemuri

programme.title: லக்ஷ்மி
programme.sub-title: Maha, her family's primary breadwinner, wants to keep supporting her family even after marrying Selvam. However, things become complicated as obstacles test their family bonds and marriage
programme.desc: மகா செல்வத்தை திருமணம் செய்தபிறகும், தாய் வீட்டை ஆதரிக்க நினைக்கும்போது, தடைகளால் அவர்களின் குடும்பத்தில் சிக்கலானது.

programme.title: ஆனந்த ராகம்
programme.sub-title: The smart and beautiful Eshwari is adored by her family members. Circumstances make her cross path with Azhagu Sundaram, who hails from a rich family
programme.desc: புத்திசாலியும் அழகும் கொண்ட ஈஸ்வரியை சூழ்நிலைகள் ஒரு பணக்கார குடும்பத்தை சேர்ந்த அழகு சுந்தரத்துடன் சந்திக்க வைக்கின்றன.

programme.title: மூவி டு பி அனௌன்ஸ்ட்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in cinema
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி சினிமாவில் மிகவும் சிறந்தவைகளைக் கொண்டுவருகின்றது.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents a compilation of the latest updates and developments pertaining to politics, sports, social and economic news
programme.desc: அரசியல், விளையாட்டு, சமூக மற்றும் பொருளாதார செய்திகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் மேம்பாடுகளின் தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: ராமாயணம்
programme.sub-title: Lord Rama and various other figures in Valmiki's Ramayana and Tulsidas's 'Ramcharitmanas' go through trials and tribulations to achieve their goals and protect their loved ones
programme.desc: ராமர் இலக்குகளை அடையவும், தங்கள் அன்புக்குரியவர்களைப் பாதுகாக்கவும் சோதனைகள் மற்றும் இன்னல்களைக் கடந்து செல்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: அன்னம்
programme.sub-title: Annam, a bright and cheerful young woman, faces the challenges of life while withstanding the harsh treatment from her stepmother
programme.desc: மகிழ்ச்சியான இளம் பெண் அன்னம், தனது மாற்றாந்தாயின் கொடுமைகளை சகித்துக்கொண்டு வாழ்க்கையின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

programme.title: கயல்
programme.sub-title: Kayal, a selfless woman, earns to provide for her family after her father abandons them. Despite being overwhelmed with responsibilities, she puts her loved ones' well-being before her own happiness
programme.desc: தந்தைக்கு பின் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளில் மூழ்கியுள்ள கயல், மகிழ்ச்சியை விட அன்புக்குரியவர்களின் நலனையே முன்னிறுத்துகிறாள்.

programme.title: மருமகள்
programme.sub-title: Prabhu is a miser and puts his needs ahead of his family. Circumstances bring him closer to Aadhirai, who helps others selflessly
programme.desc: பிரபு, தன் குடும்பத்தை விட தன் தேவைகளுக்கு முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறான். ஆதிரையிடம் தன்னலமின்றி மற்றவர்களுக்கு உதவுகிறாள்.

programme.title: மூன்று முடிச்சு
programme.sub-title: Nandini, a vivacious girl, gets married to Suryakumar, a businessman. However, the couple strives to navigate their relationship along with balancing familial responsibilities
programme.desc: தொழிலதிபர் சூர்யகுமாரை மணக்கும் சுறுசுறுப்பான நந்தினி,இருவரும் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளின் மூலம் உறவை வழிநடத்த முயலுகிறார்கள்.

credits.actor: Swathi Konde,Prabhakaran Chandran,Krithika Laddu,Niyaz Khan,Preethi Sanjiv

programme.title: சிங்கப்பெண்ணே
programme.sub-title: A group of renowned television personalities engage in a series of entertaining challenges and competitions in order to emerge victorious
programme.desc: தொடர்ச்சியான பொழுதுபோக்கு சவால்கள் மற்றும் போட்டிகளில் ஈடுபடும் பிரபல தொலைக்காட்சி பிரமுகர்களை கொண்ட கலகலப்பான கேம் ஷோ.

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல் தொடர்கிறது
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஆதிமுத்து குணசேகரனின் வீழ்ச்சியைத் தொடர்ந்து, ​​தங்கள் லட்சிய பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகின்றனர்.

credits.actor: Madhumitha Hirannaiah,Kaniha,Haripriya Isai,Vela Ramamoorthy,Sabari Prasanth,Vibhu Raman

programme.title: ரஞ்சினி
programme.sub-title: Ranjani and her close-knit friendship with four men is often frowned upon by society. However, she proves to the world that friendships transcend gender boundaries
programme.desc: ரஞ்சனி, நான்கு ஆண்களுடனான தனது நெருங்கிய நட்பு பாலின எல்லைக்கு அப்பாற்பட்டது என்பதை உலகுக்கு நிரூபிக்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மல்லி
programme.sub-title: A bodacious village girl's life transforms when she bonds with a loving father and his daughter, uncovering the true meaning of love, family and belonging
programme.desc: தந்தையுடனும் அவரது மகளுடனும் பிணைந்து, காதல், குடும்பம் மற்றும் சொந்தம் என்பதன் உண்மையான அர்த்தத்தைக் கண்டறிகின்றனர்.

credits.actor: Madhan Bob,Nikitha Rajesh,Vijay Venkatesan,Poornima Bhagyaraj,Poornima Jayaram

programme.title: மலர்
programme.sub-title: Sisters Malar and Parvathi who share a close bond navigate various challenges in their lives. While her family is of utmost importance to Malar, Parvathi wishes to find a life partner
programme.desc: சகோதரிகளான மலர் குடும்பத்துக்கு முக்கியத்துவம் அளிக்கிறாள், பார்வதியோ வாழ்க்கை துணையை கண்டுபிடிக்க விரும்புகிறார்.

programme.title: புது வசந்தம்
programme.sub-title: While the parents search for a suitable prospect for their daughter Selvi's marriage, she expresses her desire to get married to a joint family
programme.desc: பெற்றோர் தனக்கு திருமணத்திற்கு வரன் தேடும்போது, கூட்டுக் குடும்பத்தில் திருமணம் செய்ய விருப்பம் தெரிவிக்கும் செல்வி.

credits.actor: Nathan Shyam (Thirumurugan),Surjith Ansary (Sundar),Soniya Suresh (Selvi Velmurugan),Shyam Ji (Velmurugan),Vaishnavi Nayak (Keerthi Thirumurugan)

programme.desc: అనేకమంది భక్తులు కలిసి భక్తి శ్లోకమైన గణపతి స్తోత్రంతో వినాయకుడిని ఆరాధిస్తూ, స్వామి ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరతారు.

programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు యాదగిరి లక్ష్మీ నరసింహస్వామిని స్తుతిస్తూ ఆయన దీవెనలు పొందేందుకు కీర్తనల సంకలనాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: కాకడ హారతి
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees gather together to sing devotional hymns and perform sacred rituals in honour of Shirdi Sai Baba

programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర స్వామివారి కృపాకటాక్షాలు కోరుతూ మతపరమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహించి, భక్తి గీతాలు ఆలపిస్తారు.

programme.title: గణపతి స్తోత్రం

programme.title: యాదాద్రి సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: Hindu priests and devotees chant a comprehensive compilation of hymns in praise of Yadagiri Laxmi Narasimha Swamy to seek the blessings of the Almighty
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు యాదగిరి లక్ష్మీ నరసింహస్వామిని స్తుతిస్తూ ఆయన దీవెనలు పొందేందుకు కీర్తనల సంకలనాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: కాకడ హారతి
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees gather together to sing devotional hymns and perform sacred rituals in honour of Shirdi Sai Baba
programme.desc: షిర్డీ సాయిబాబా గౌరవార్థం ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు ఒకచోట చేరి శ్లోకాలు పఠిస్తూ, పవిత్రమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: In veneration of Lord Venkateswara, devotees and priests listen to devotional songs and perform religious customs in order to seek his blessings

programme.title: खबर खटाखट

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: நாச்சியார்
programme.sub-title: A diligent and determined police officer, sets out to catch the culprit who assaulted an underage girl who is being hidden by her uncle and his henchmen
programme.desc: ஒரு விடாமுயற்சியும் உறுதியும் கொண்ட காவல்துறை அதிகாரி, ஒரு பெண்ணைத் தாக்கிய குற்றவாளியைப் பிடிக்க புறப்படுகிறார்.

credits.actor: Jyothika (P. Naachiyaar Kumari IPS(Tejaswani)),G.V. Prakash Kumar (Kaathavarayan (Karan)),Ivana (Kottaiarasi (Arusi)),Rockline Venkatesh (Feroz Khan),Kulappulli Leela,Dr. Gurushankar (Naachiyaar's husband)

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hilarious comedy scenes, featuring popular artists, is played back-to-back for the entertainment of the viewers
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: வா: குவாட்டர் கட்டிங்
programme.sub-title: While Sura is on his way to Saudi Arabia, he meets his soon-to-be brother-in-law Marthandam in Chennai. Subsequently, the duo go on a desperate search of liquor on a dry day
programme.desc: சுரா சவுதி அரேபியாவுக்குச் செல்லும் வழியில், சென்னையில் தனது மைத்துனராகப் போகும் மார்த்தாண்டத்தை சந்திக்கிறார்.

programme.title: சாங்க்ஸ்

programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற இசைக்கலைஞர்களால் இசையமைக்கப்பட்டு, தமிழ் திரைப்படங்களில் பல்வேறு கலைஞர்கள் நிகழ்த்திய மெல்லிசை பாடல்கள்.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.sub-title: Ramanuja, a learned philosopher, travels the subcontinent and brings his teachings to ardent followers of the Hindu faith
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: ஸ்லாட்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி தொலைக்காட்சியில் மிகவும் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருகிறது.

programme.title: சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular and famous songs produced and composed by talented musical artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: திறமையான இசைக் கலைஞர்கள் தயாரித்து இசையமைத்த பிரபலமான பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பு அடுத்தடுத்து இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news stories and developments pertaining to various political and socio-economic issues around the country
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: விடியலே வா
programme.sub-title: The host provides information on various trending topics related to fitness, technology, finance, society, economy and culture and interviews experts on them

programme.title: ஸ்நேகிதியே
programme.sub-title: The host engages in discussions on topics related to women's issues, along with home and lifestyle tips
programme.desc: வீடு மற்றும் வாழ்க்கை முறை குறிப்புகளுடன் பெண்களின் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான தலைப்புகளில் விவாதங்களில் ஈடுபடுகிறது.

programme.title: அழகி
programme.sub-title: Sundari, a widow, raises her three children, Natraj, Mathi and Surya with love and support amidst several hardships. But, things turn bad in the family when Natraj gets married to a rich girl
programme.desc: விதவை சுந்தரியின் மூன்று மகன்களில் ஒருவரான நட்ராஜ் பணக்கார பெண்ணை மணக்கும்போது குடும்பத்தில் விஷயங்கள் மோசமாகிறது.

programme.title: நாதஸ்வரம்
programme.sub-title: Gopi, the owner of a tailor shop and son of Chokkalingam, a Nadaswaram player, goes about his daily life, with several ups and downs, along with his family
programme.desc: தையல்கடை உரிமையாளரும், நாதஸ்வரம் வாசிக்கும் சொக்கலிங்கத்தின் மகனுமான கோபி பல ஏற்ற தாழ்வுகளை குடும்பத்தோடு கடக்கிறார்.

programme.title: வைல்ட் பை நேச்சர்
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: பல வாழ்விடங்கள் மற்றும் விலங்குகளை ஆராய்ந்து, அவற்றைப் பற்றிய சுவாரஸ்யமான உண்மைகளை பகிரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலரான ஆர்துரோ.

programme.title: Sharkzilla Takes New York
programme.desc: After a slew of mauled marine life washes ashore in NY, Dr. Craig O'Connell starts a search to find the culprit. When it leads him to an old nuclear dumping ground ringed with great whites and makos, he theorizes that the predator may be radioactive.

programme.title: வைல்டெஸ்ட் சர்வைவல்
programme.sub-title: Discover how some of the world's most extraordinary animals are also the smallest. This action-packed episode will take you deep into rainforests, under the oceans and across vast deserts
programme.desc: உணவை வேட்டையாட மற்றும் உயிர் வாழ மற்றும் காடுகளில் நிலைக்க பல்வேறு உயிர் தந்திரங்களை பயன்படுத்தும் காட்டு மிருகங்கள்.

programme.title: அ சீட்டா'ஸ் ப்ரைட்
programme.sub-title: Rejoin the cheetah family as the mothers collaborate to keep the cubs fed, then watch the cubs survive abandonment and harsh conditions
programme.desc: Witness a wildlife first: two cheetah mothers unite to raise nine cubs in South Africa's Karoo, overcoming danger, loss, and the odds to survive.

programme.title: அட்டன்பரோ'ஸ் லைஃப் இன் கலர்
programme.sub-title: David Attenborough reveals the extraordinary ways that some animals use colour to hide and disappear into the background. New science reveals how the Bengal tiger in central India uses its orange-black stripes to hide from its colour-blind prey. In Kenya's Masai Mara, the zebra's black-and-white pattern confuses predators with an extraordinary effect called motion dazzle. And on the island of Cuba, a small snail uses colourful stripes surprisingly to hide from its enemies
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the vital role that colour plays in the daily life of various species. For us humans, it is a source of aesthetic beauty and expression, but for animals it is an essential tool used for survival and without it, there would be catastrophic consequences. Colours help animals to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies. Attenborough explores nature's use of colour using technological advancements in camera equipment to reveal the world, as seen by animals.

programme.title: வைல்ட் ஃபைட்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The love rivalry shakes every fibre of the body as hormones invade the blood, and some of the most overwhelming spectacles on the planet are produced; the language of love and the fight for reproduction stimulate the most diverse behaviours
programme.desc: உலகின் பல்வேறு பகுதிகளில் உயிர்வாழ்வதற்காக வன விலங்குகள் பின்பற்றும் பல்வேறு உத்திகள் மற்றும் வழிமுறைகளை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.sub-title: Following a family of spotted hyenas on the Liuwa Plains in western Zambia through one of the toughest seasons in living memory
programme.desc: முக்கிய ஆபிரிக்க விலங்குகளின் நடத்தை, அம்சங்கள், இரையை கொல்ல மற்றும் தங்களை பாதுகாக்க உபயோகிக்கும் உத்திகளை பாருங்கள்.

programme.title: த லயன்ஸ் ரூல்
programme.sub-title: During the dry season in Ruaha state, a herd of elephants visits the water body at Glade to extract the cleanest water using their trunks
programme.desc: உணவுக்காக வேட்டையாடவும், தங்கள் நிலப்பரப்பைப் பாதுகாக்கவும் ஒன்றாக வரும் கம்பீரமான ஆப்பிரிக்க சிங்கங்களின் கதை.

programme.title: ட்ராப்ஸ் அண்ட் ஆம்புஷஸ்
programme.sub-title: Looks at intricate, trap-like structures that animals build to capture prey
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: தி லெப்பர்ட்ரஸ்
programme.sub-title: The Serengeti and its labyrinth of gallery forests are the home of a leopardess. To her family she is both caring provider and fearless defender. For her prey she is sudden death, for her son the only chance to survive in this unforgiving wilderness
programme.desc: சிறுத்தைகளின் இயற்கையான வாழ்விடங்களில் படம்பிடித்து, பூனை வேட்டையாடும் விலங்குகளின் வாழ்க்கை-உயிர்வாழும் தந்திரங்கள்.

programme.title: அட்டன்பரோ'ஸ் லைஃப் இன் கலர்
programme.sub-title: David Attenborough reveals the extraordinary ways that some animals use colour to hide and disappear into the background. New science reveals how the Bengal tiger in central India uses its orange-black stripes to hide from its colour-blind prey. In Kenya's Masai Mara, the zebra's black-and-white pattern confuses predators with an extraordinary effect called motion dazzle. And on the island of Cuba, a small snail uses colourful stripes surprisingly to hide from its enemies
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the vital role that colour plays in the daily life of various species. For us humans, it is a source of aesthetic beauty and expression, but for animals it is an essential tool used for survival and without it, there would be catastrophic consequences. Colours help animals to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies. Attenborough explores nature's use of colour using technological advancements in camera equipment to reveal the world, as seen by animals.

programme.title: கேங்க்ஸ் ஆஃப் பாபூன் ஃபால்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: As lockdown continues, the streets of Victoria Falls have become eerily deserted, and the gangs must now figure out new ways to survive in a dramatically changed world
programme.desc: சக்மா பாபூன்களின் நான்குகுழுக்கள் ஜிம்பாப்வே மேலும் ஜாம்பியாவின் எல்லையில் உணவு-பிராந்திய சக்திகளுக்கு போட்டியிடுகின்றன.

programme.title: ஆஃப்ரிக்கா'ஸ் சூப்பர் ஸ்னேக்
programme.sub-title: She has no hands, no arms, no legs, but she'll crush you to death in 15 minutes. She's an African rock python, and she's queen of the constrictors
programme.desc: ஆப்பிரிக்க ராக் மலைப்பாம்பின் மனிதனை உண்ணும் போக்குகள் மற்றும் ஒடுக்கும் திறனால் கொடிய விலங்குகளில் ஒன்றாக மாறுகிறது.

programme.title: பிக்கெஸ்ட் மேக்கோ ஆன் எர்த்
programme.sub-title: A new report of a 15-foot mako shark off the coast of Mexico shatters conventional wisdom on how large these sharks can grow. A team of experts heads to the Pacific Ocean to track down this mega shark and find the biggest mako in the world
programme.desc: மெக்சிகோ கடற்கரையில் 15 அடி நீளமுள்ள மாக்கோ சுறா காணப்பட்ட தகவல், அவற்றின் வளர்ச்சி குறித்த பழைய நம்பிக்கைகளை உடைத்துள்ளது. இதனால், உலகின் மிகப்பெரிய இந்த சுறாவைக் கண்டுபிடிக்க நிபுணர் குழு ஒன்று பசிபிக் பெருங்கடலுக்கு செல்கிறது.

programme.title: ப்ரீடேட்டர் கவுண்டவுன்
programme.sub-title: A closer look at Australia's arid landscape and the incredible battles between predators and prey, including a large monitor lizard, saltwater crocodiles and more
programme.desc: வேட்டையாடும் விலங்குகள், அவற்றின் மூர்க்கத்தனம் மற்றும் உயிர் பிழைப்பதற்கான மீள்திறன் ஆகியவற்றைப் பற்றிய ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: Jaguar: King of the Jungle
programme.desc: The jaguar is the third largest of the big cats, and pound for pound, the most powerful. This jaguar patrols a home range of over 100 square kilometres in Brazil, deep in the heart of the world's largest tropical rainforest.

programme.title: The Strongest Of The Savannah
programme.desc: The Strongest Of The Savannah.

programme.sub-title: Explores how the wild predators, including grizzly bears and great white sharks, use their dangerous bite to chomp down their hunted preys viciously
programme.desc: மிகவும் ஆபத்தான சில விலங்குகள் மற்றும் அவை காடுகளில் உயிர்வாழப் பயன்படுத்தும் கொடிய ஆயுதங்கள் பற்றிய ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: தி க்ரேட் ரைனோ ராபரி

credits.actor: Steven R. Galster,Paolo Viscardi,Paulo Mota,William Fowlds

programme.title: வைல்ட் கேட்ஸ்

programme.desc: மிகவும் சவாலான சில பகுதிகளில் உயிர்வாழ்வதற்காகப் போராட தங்கள் திறன்களைப் பயன்படுத்தும் தீய காட்டு பூனைகளின் பல இனங்கள்.

programme.title: அனிமல்ஸ் அட் நைட்
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: பிக் பீஸ்ட்ஸ்: லாஸ்ட் ஆஃப் தி ஜெயண்ட்ஸ்

programme.sub-title: From wasps to chimpanzees, from large vultures to small birds or even fishes, a wide variety of animals use different tools in order to survive in the wild

programme.title: தி லெப்பர்ட் ராக்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: In a remote, little-known region of Rajasthan, leopards display astonishing behaviour. A mother, called Neelam, protects her three cubs from roaming adult males
programme.desc: ராஜஸ்தானின் தொலைதூர, ஒதுக்குப்புறமான பகுதியில், சிறுத்தைகள் செழித்து வளர்ந்து வியக்கத்தக்க நடத்தையை வெளிப்படுத்துகின்றன.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீலங்கா - லெப்பர்ட்ஸ் ஆஃப் யாலா
programme.sub-title: Follow the trials and tribulations of a group of leopards in Yala National Park
programme.desc: இலங்கையின் யாலா தேசிய பூங்காவில் வாழும் சிறுத்தைகளின் நடத்தை, உயிர்வாழும் உத்திகள் மற்றும் சவால்களை ஆராயும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: பிக் கேட்ஸ்: அன் அமேசிங் அனிமல் ஃபேமிலி
programme.sub-title: Patrick Aryee comes within a whisker of some of Earth's most majestic predators as he embarks on a remarkable journey through the feline family tree
programme.desc: காடுகளில் ஆதிக்கம் செலுத்தும் 37 வகையான வேட்டை பூனைகளின் வெற்றியையும், அவற்றின் குடும்ப மரத்தையும் பற்றிய ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: ஆன் த ட்ரெய்ல் ஆஃப் ஸ்னோ லெப்பர்ட்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the search for snow leopards and records the experiences of experts who witness the rare sight of these animals moving around in rocky landscapes
programme.desc: பனி சிறுத்தைகளை தேடி, பாறை நிலப்பரப்புகளில் அவை நடமாடும் அரிய காட்சியை காணும் நிபுணர்களின் அனுபவங்களை அறியும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: சர்வைவிங்க் அர்த்
programme.sub-title: A heartwarming coming-of-age story about a hatchling who grows to be a leader of her herd, helping ensure the survival of future generations
programme.desc: An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

programme.title: சீக்ரட் க்ரீச்சர்ஸ் ஆஃப் தாய்லேண்ட்
programme.desc: Secret Creatures Of Thailand.

programme.sub-title: Mountains, rocks and steep cliffs, no place for a predator relying on their speed. But that's exactly where we find our two magnificent Cheetah mothers. Hidden between the mountains, open savannah plains miraculously appear. And on these savannahs
programme.desc: இயக்குனர் சமவெளியில் ஒளிந்து,உணவு சேகரிக்க,குட்டியை காக்க வேகத்தை நம்பும் அச்சமற்ற இரு சிறுத்தைகளை காண்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ
programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe
programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: శివ రుద్ర వర్సెస్ పైరేట్స్ ఆఫ్ యూనివర్స్
programme.sub-title: When people start disappearing, Shiva, a child superhero, and Rudra, a young magician, join forces to battle the Pirates of the Universe
programme.desc: ప్రజలు అదృశ్యమవ్వడం మొదలైనప్పుడు, సూపర్ హీరో అయిన శివ, మాంత్రికుడైన రుద్ర, విశ్వపు సముద్రపు దొంగలతో పోరాడటానికి జట్టుకడతారు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.desc: Comedians Reiji and Tsuyoshi of the duo Nakagawake and Suchiko explore the many wonders of Japanese manufacturing. They learn about the latest technology and even try their hand at expert skills.

programme.title: Time-Lapse Japan
programme.sub-title: Since ancient times, safflowers grown in Yonezawa have been used to dye fabric a deep red colour associated with the sun. You can experience its mysterious, vivid beauty through time-lapse footage
programme.desc: Shimizu Daisuke investigates various aspects of Japanese culture and traditions using the technique of time-lapse photography.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: Hourly news updates featuring current affairs, business news, financial updates and global weather forecasts.

programme.title: Ekiben Japan
programme.sub-title: There's a brand-new ekiben in Okinawa, Japan's southern prefecture. Featuring beloved local dishes with a long history, it's sparking a new ekiben culture in the region
programme.desc: Having a look at an Ekiben prepared using ash from Kagoshima's active Sakurajima volcano, which enhances the flavour of seasonal seafood.

programme.title: Nun's Cookbook
programme.sub-title: The nuns of Otowasan Kannonji Temple prepare shinoda rolls with taro stalks, a simple autumn dish
programme.desc: Highlighting the nuns of Otowasan Kannonji Temple as they cook up a storm. They invite the viewer inside their kitchen and showcase how to prepare tasty delicacies from their seasonal cookbook.

programme.title: Hometown Stories
programme.desc: Intimate portraits of people from around Japan, each leading diverse lives while enriching lives of others, with themes ranging from ancient traditions to contemporary social issues.

programme.title: Easy Japanese
programme.sub-title: The Haru-san house's residents go on a vacation in Kyoto. They stay in a traditional wooden townhouse called a machiya and demonstrate how to connect two opposing adjectives in one sentence
programme.desc: Teaches the Japanese language with the meanings of various words and their correct usage with context.

programme.title: NHK Newsline

programme.title: NHK World Selection

programme.sub-title: The nuns of Otowasan Kannonji Temple prepare a delightful autumn treat that's both beautiful to look at and tasty to eat by simply boiling edible chrysanthemums and serving them with sweet vinegar
programme.desc: Highlighting the nuns of Otowasan Kannonji Temple as they cook up a storm. They invite the viewer inside their kitchen and showcase how to prepare tasty delicacies from their seasonal cookbook.

programme.title: Magical Japanese

programme.title: Easy Japanese

programme.title: Culture Crossroads
programme.desc: Comprised of several regular programs with the theme of creating a multicultural society. Answering questions about Japan from foreign viewers, looking at international exchange programs, and giving tips on disaster preparedness.

programme.title: Hello! NHK WORLD-JAPAN
programme.sub-title: Following the passing of Yayoi Kusama on August 14, we look back on her life and artistic legacy through rare archival footage and past programmes
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan introduces several of its programmes to a global audience, like special reports and documentaries. These programmes provide the world with a window into the Japanese station and offer the latest in Japanese news.

programme.title: Direct Talk

programme.desc: Interviews with leaders, academics, visionaries and entrepreneurs whose work is changing the world. Offers insight into those who are applying their skills to solve challenges at a local, regional and international level.
